400.body: The company said the expansion, involving investments of tens of millions of euros in machinery, infrastructure and space optimisation, is aimed at preparing the plant for the next generation of offshore wind turbine foundations. EEW SPC has manufactured monopiles, pin piles and other large-diameter pipe components at Rostock’s Overseas Port since 2008.
